arguments.rationale: TENT-731 satisfies user mandate: price $69 (within $100 limit), independent lab certificate CERT-7318 with quality score 4.8 (exceeds 4.0 minimum), and multiple verified purchases (REV-R11/R12/R13/R14) confirming durable 4P performance in heavy weather. TENT-284 is unsuitable: its certificate CERT-4107 is scope-limited to 2P variant only; the 4P configuration sold has no valid certification and reported failures in pole hubs and seams matching the scope gap.
